standard: docs/RECHECK-RUNNER.md with the 2.34 / 27 Sep grade standard as the 1.17.2 strategy review applied it: a grade moves one step at most, a move needs a kit or patch reason plus evidence the same way, a drop without a kit reason needs a 95% interval over at least 500 games to exclude the previous review rate with the games since review agreeing (the rule permits a drop; it does not require one), and a high rate alone never raises a grade. C is the lowest defined grade.

entries.reason: B to C under the drop rule. The 1.17.2 strategy review raised her C to B on the 1.17.2 Highland Hurl changes (armor scaling, more shred, a 1.25s slow or root at every rank) plus 49.7% over 632, and flagged that raise as worth an early recheck because the rise sat inside the interval. The Gold+ 1.17.2 offlane line is now 46.6% over 1,887 [44.39, 48.89], which excludes the 49.7% review rate with more than 500 games, and the games since the review (about 45.1% over 1,255) point the same way. No official text changed since the review (both live articles match the packet's fingerprints). Her results are back at her 1.17 line (46.4% over 908), so the evidence no longer supports the buff lifting her; the interval sits wholly below the offlane role average (49.97% over 62,238), and the engine's calculated tier for Gold+ is C. Offlane C peers sit at the same level: Bayle 46.7% over 2,770, Adele 46.1% over 1,325. One step, as the rule allows. The watch text states the new grade and why.
entries.limitation: Rate-only evidence; no in-game test. Sevarog offlane keeps B at 46.7% over 2,181 [44.64, 48.82], the same level; it is not queued (its grade is not withheld), so this pass did not review it, and the owner may want it rechecked for consistency. Bronze+ (nested, not independent) is 46.3% over 3,954 [44.76, 47.86], the same picture.
